The problem of certifying large value estimates for random matrices is part of the field of average case computational complexity. For a broad class of related problems in the field, the best current method is called the sum of squares hierarchy. The limits of this method are well understood in a number of cases. It is not understood what value estimates for a random matrix M can be certified by the sum of squares method, but there was a lot of recent progress in [DHPT] .
